claims.text: W-Ta-Ti-V-Cr high-entropy alloys are candidate materials for fusion applications.
The initial W-Ta-Ti-V-Cr alloy has a multiphase microstructure.
The initial alloy has an unoptimized dispersion of secondary phases.
Spark plasma sintering can consolidate W-Ta-Ti-V-Cr alloys containing in-situ-formed TiC.
The W content of this alloy system can be varied or tuned over a broad compositional range.
The processed material contains a BCC matrix with TiC in W-rich regions.
The TiC forms a fine nanoscale dispersion within the BCC matrix.
An optimized W concentration induces lattice strain.
TiC particles impede dislocation motion and thereby provide dispersion strengthening.
W-related lattice strain enhances solid-solution strengthening in the alloy.
The combination of TiC dispersion strengthening and W-related solid-solution strengthening governs high-temperature dislocation behavior.
The combined strengthening mechanisms increase high-temperature plastic strain and toughness.
The intervention maintains or increases yield strength relative to conventional sintering.
The proposed mechanism applies from approximately 600°C to 1500°C provided that overwhelming phase instability does not occur.
C15 Laves phases can occur in V- and Cr-rich regions at W contents above 70 at.%.
Secondary phases such as Laves phases may affect high-temperature plastic strain or toughness.
Comparing spark-plasma-sintered material with conventionally sintered material of identical nominal composition will isolate the hypothesized cause.
A lack of statistically significant improvement in both high-temperature plastic strain and toughness would falsify the hypothesis.

contradictions.description: The intervention includes precise tuning of W content, while the comparison is also specified to use identical nominal compositions. If W content differs, composition is not controlled; if it is identical, W-content tuning is not an independently varied intervention. The comparison additionally changes sintering route and TiC formation together, so it cannot isolate either proposed cause.
